mappings.note: Why the narrator refused the kheera, answered 'path ke aadhar par' -- the reason is in the text (self-respect after the Nawab's condescension). Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2 because the item asks for a character's motive, not for Yashpal's mantavya or shaili.

The path only supplies the prompt; the whole answer is the student's own account of how they pass a solitary journey. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-1 because no part of the required answer comes from the prose text's vishayvastu -- this is srijanatmak/vyavaharik lekhan.

The second half asks which pravritti this manner of 'eating' reveals in a person -- precisely the attitude the piece satirises. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-1 because the shorter MCQ that stops at 'can the stomach be filled' is the LO-1 item; this one demands the critical reading.

Infer, from cues in the text, why the Nawab travelled second class -- character motive with textual support. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2 because the answer is about the character's circumstances, not about the writer's comment on the class.
Which change of manner displeased the narrator and why -- both halves are answerable from the narrated episode. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2 because no appraisal of Yashpal's intent or style is required.

Why the Nawab showed no enthusiasm for the narrator's company -- inference about a character drawn from his described behaviour. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2 because the item asks about the character's disposition rather than about the satire the writer builds on it.
